user.title: Connect an existing Oasis mesh lamp
user.description: Copy your private mesh export onto Home Assistant first. Use a NEW, unused mesh sender address for this installation (32766 is different from the Mac test sender 32767). Never reuse a sender after losing or restoring its sequence database. Setup only authenticates a beacon; it does not reset or change the lamp.

data.mesh_file: Absolute path to private mesh-export.json on Home Assistant
data.lamp_name: Lamp name in the mesh export
data.address: Bluetooth address shown by Home Assistant (not the Mac UUID)
data.new_sender_confirmed: This sender is unused, or its original sequence database is intact

error.confirm_sender: Confirm the sender address is safe to use.
error.not_found: Home Assistant cannot see a connectable Bluetooth device at this address.
error.invalid_mesh: Check the export, lamp name, sender allocation, and sequence storage. No keys are logged.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or authenticate the lamp. Disconnect phone BLE tools and retry.
